ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the Office of Foreign Assets Control Specially Designated Nationals list, the European Union consolidated sanctions list, the United Nations Security Council sanctions list, the Luxembourg domestic sanctions lists, and the Financial Action Task Force high-risk jurisdiction list. Enhanced due diligence is required for all politically exposed persons, their family members, and known close associates; cross-referencing is performed on all directors, managers, shareholders, UBOs, and contractual counterparts. A risk-based approach and written AML/CFT policy must be implemented in accordance with the Law of 12 November 2004, as amended.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCSL); portal: www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be identifiable and available in the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register. The constitutive instruments may be drafted in French, German, or Luxembourgish; the RCSL registration standard is French. Names must use the Latin alphabet, avoid misleading similarity to existing registrations, and respect mandatory designation requirements for the chosen legal form.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon refusal by the RCSL, the applicant may submit a reasoned written objection to the RCSL for administrative reconsideration. If the rejection is maintained, a formal appeal may be filed with the Administrative Tribunal of Luxembourg within three months from notification of the refusal; representation by a Luxembourg licensed lawyer is mandatory. The court evaluates compliance with the Law of 19 December 2002 on the RCS and the naming rules of the Law of 10 August 1915, as amended.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office is mandatory and must be a real physical address in Luxembourg where the company's statutory books and corporate documents are kept. Virtual office services are not acceptable as the sole registered office for substance-dependent activities; they may serve only as a supplementary correspondence address. For tax and commercial substance purposes, the company must demonstrate premises, personnel, and decision-making presence proportionate to its wholesale trading activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium; approximately 20% probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first three years for a medium-risk non-financial metals trading entity, given Luxembourg tax authority and administrative inspection practices.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (notably by the Law of 23 September 2020 on the Modernisation of the SARL), Articles 710-1 et seq. on the Societe a Responsabilite Limitee; Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies; Civil Code Articles 1832 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Societes (RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), 3 rue du Saint-Esprit, L-1475 Luxembourg
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif (Articles of Association / Statuts), executed by notarial deed (acte notarie) or private deed (acte sous seing prive), filed electronically with the RCS
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital EUR 12,000; 100% fully subscribed and paid up in cash at incorporation; evidenced by a banker's certificate (attestation bancaire) issued by a Luxembourg credit institution; funds are blocked until RCS registration and released only upon issuance of the registration number; in-kind contributions require a statutory auditor's report (rapport du reviseur d'entreprises).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company's share capital of EUR 12,000 (twelve thousand euros), fully subscribed and paid up in cash, be and is hereby confirmed as allocated to the founding quota-holders as set forth in Schedule 1, the proceeds being evidenced by the banker's certificate issued by a Luxembourg credit institution. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at [Registered Address], Luxembourg. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [Name] be and is hereby appointed as sole Gerant (Manager), with full powers to act solely and severally, to open bank accounts, and to complete all registrations, filings and declarations with the RCS, tax, social security and other competent Luxembourg authorities. ADOPTED unanimously by the sole quota-holder on [Date], Luxembourg.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) via the eJustice portal (guichet RCS) or instructed through a Luxembourg notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed corporate names for availability screening against the RCS and the Business Entities Database (BECD); obtain the certificate of non-confusion (name reservation) before drafting statutes; a notary can run the check directly in notarial practice if chosen.
required_dossiers: Identity document (passport) of each founder and ultimate beneficial owner
Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refusal is based on confusing similarity, re-file a revised application with a differentiating element (activity, geographic or graphic mark); appeal to the RCS jurisdictional chamber within 8 days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Capital Deposit Account and Banker's Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (e.g. BIL, BCEE, BGL BNP Paribas, ING Luxembourg) subject to CSSF AML rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a non-operational capital deposit account in the intended company name; wire EUR 12,000 of fully paid-up share capital; complete standard KYC/AML due diligence; obtain the attestation bancaire confirming subscription and blocking, valid for the notary and the RCS.
required_dossiers: Passport copies and UBO declarations of shareholders
Completed bank KYC/AML questionnaires and source-of-funds statements
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries UBO documentation, supplement with certified corporate register extracts and source-of-wealth evidence; direct the bank to CSSF guidance on simplified due diligence for regulated Luxembourg formations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of Statutes and Pre-Incorporation Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary or registered corporate counsel; no administrative pre-approval required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalise the statuts covering the corporate object (wholesale trade and cross-border procurement of metals, ores and battery-grade lithium carbonate), registered office in Luxembourg, quota structure, management powers, audit thresholds and quota transfer restrictions; confirm no in-kind contribution, so no statutory auditor's report is required.
required_dossiers: Draft statutes containing object clause, address, capital and management powers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the RCS pre-review flags an invalid object clause, amend the object wording to conform with permitted activities under Article 710-1 of the Law of 1915 and re-notarise.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Incorporation Deed and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Parties meet, or act through powers of attorney, to execute the deed before the notary; the notary authenticates the statuts, the quota allocation and the acceptance of office by the first Gerant; the first board resolution (per pro-forma text) is adopted and recorded in minutes appended to the deed.
required_dossiers: Executed powers of attorney if representative signatories
Certified corporate documents for any corporate quota-holder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a signature or exhibit is missing, schedule a supplementary deed (acte rectificatif) before the same notary; correction within the 5-business-day RCS filing window preserves filing priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Societes (RCS), Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), electronic filing channel under the Law of 19 December 2002
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary files the deed digitally with the RCS via the secured e-submission service together with the first board resolution and proof of deposit; after formal scrutiny the RCS assigns the national registration number, legal personality takes effect on that registration date, and the EUR 15.00 registration tax is collected online.
required_dossiers: Statements of acceptance by officers (if not in the deed)
RCS e-file checklist and online payment confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a refusal due to incomplete exhibits, remedy the deficiency and re-submit within 15 days; if refusal persists, lodge a reclamation with the RCS administrative chamber and thereafter to the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in RESA and Post-Incorporation Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RESA); Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Administration des contributions directes (ACD); Centre commun de la securite sociale (CCSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The RCS triggers publication of the incorporative notice in RESA (electronic, free of charge, constitutive effect); simultaneously apply for VAT registration (TVA LU number) before the AEDT for turnover on battery-grade lithium carbonate; register for corporate income tax and municipal business tax before the ACD; enrol as employer with the CCSS (declaration of gerant and staff).
required_dossiers: Bank certificate of the operational account
Estimate of first 12 months turnover for AEDT
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RESA notice is delayed beyond 10 days, request an official attestation from LBR; if the VAT number is delayed, require AEDT to backdate the VAT effective date to incorporation date under Article 57 of the VAT law, preserving invoice neutrality.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministere de l'Economie - Direction de l'industrie et de l'innovation (Industrial Licensing Directorate) - not applicable to pure wholesale trading
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'exploitation d'un etablissement classe (Law of 9 May 2014 on Classified Installations) - not required for an office-based trading and procurement SARL without physical plant, warehousing or dangerous substance storage; authorisation only if logistics or warehousing activity is added

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA or environmental authorisation for wholesale procurement and arbitrage trading of ISIC 4662 (metals) with no emission source; a mere administrative registration may apply if the company later operates a distribution warehouse (etablissement classe, class 4) with annual capacity below 10 tonnes of lithium carbonate (CAS 554-13-2, CLP H302/H319).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-only activity: no process wastewater, VOC or dust emission points; sanitary effluent complies with the municipal sewer discharge regulation (Grand-Ducal Regulation of 15 March 2017 limit values for domestic wastewater); battery-grade materials traded cross-border shall comply with REACH/CLP labelling (H302, H319) and, if transported as dry powder, with ADR provisions for toxic solids where thresholds apply; no Seveso III inventory obligation because lithium carbonate is not listed in Annex I of Directive 2012/18/EU.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office premises to hold a fire safety certificate (CGDIS - Administration des services de secours) for use above the ground floor, and the landlord's occupancy certificate (certificat de conformite) from the commune; employer registration with the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) for workplace safety, completion of the A1 workplace declaration, and compliance with the Law of 17 June 1994 on safety and health at work; no hazardous workplace clearance or structural load permit required for trading-only head-office functions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Luxembourg VAT and indirect taxes: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT), VAT Department; direct taxes: Administration des contributions directes (ACD); customs: Administration des Douanes et Accises. E-portal: MyGuichet (myguichet.lu); official tax portal: guichet.public.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A notarized incorporation deed is filed with the Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCSL). RCSL registration automatically generates the national business identification number (matricule) via the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE), which the ACD and AEDT use for direct tax and VAT file opening. VAT registration is made by filing Form 10 (déclaration d'assujettissement à la TVA), in practice through the MyGuichet e-form; the AEDT issues a VAT number in the format LU + 8 digits (e.g., LU12345678) typically within 2–4 weeks. The SARL must maintain a Luxembourg registered office and appoint a local manager; no additional tax representative is required for EU-resident owners. Foreign shareholders are permitted.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — a Luxembourg-resident SARL is per se subject to corporate income tax, municipal business tax and net wealth tax on worldwide profits/assets; no pass-through default applies. Territorial scope: worldwide taxation mitigated by the participation exemption (qualifying dividends and capital gains), foreign PE exemption and double tax treaties. No tax-exempt zone applies to routine trading operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists; an SARL cannot elect transparent treatment. Fiscal unity (intégration fiscale): optional CIT consolidation for fiscal years beginning on/after 1 January 2025, requiring a resident integrating parent holding at least 95% of capital and voting rights of each Luxembourg integrated company, binding for 5 years. VAT grouping (assujetti unique): election available for financially, economically and organisationally linked Luxembourg-established entities. Hybrid mismatch rules under EU ATAD 2 implemented by the law of 25 February 2021; no unilateral elective carve-outs available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA/VAT) under the amended Law of 12 February 1979 implementing EU Directive 2006/112/EC; standard headline rate 17% effective 1 January 2025 (previously 16%).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover excluding VAT (small-enterprise exemption threshold). The cross-border battery-metals arbitrage model of wholesale battery-grade lithium carbonate massively exceeds this threshold; VAT registration is compulsory with effect from the first taxable transaction, with no exemption available.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No continuous transaction control (CTC) or real-time tax-authority fiscal clearance/digital stamping applies to B2B VAT invoices in Luxembourg. B2G e-invoicing is mandatory via PEPPOL (EN 16931). VAT returns are periodic (monthly/quarterly); export and intra-Community supplies are processed through the EU ECS and Intrastat/ESL reporting systems. No tax-API invoice clearance mandate exists for export invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies under Article 54 of the VAT Law to exports of battery-grade lithium carbonate physically dispatched from Luxembourg/another EU country to a destination outside the EU, evidenced by customs export declarations. 0% also applies to intra-Community supplies under Article 53, conditional on validation of the EU customer's VAT identification number and inclusion of the supply in the periodic recapitulative statement. All zero-rating evidence must be retained for 10 years (Article 55 VAT Law).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (EU ECS export declaration evidencing the final exit of the goods, with Movement Reference Number)
Transport document — Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR consignment note proving physical exit from the EU
Commercial invoice for the battery-grade lithium carbonate (HS 2836.91) stating INCOTERM, quantity and counterparty
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 and bank statements evidencing FX settlement of the export sale
Intra-Community sales list (ESL) filing and validated EU VAT ID record for EU-destined supplies
Complete zero-rating evidence file (10-year retention) including purchase/import documents and weight certificates
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Luxembourg law fixes no explicit statutory 180-day FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark reflects the arm's-length payment cycle expected in AEDT export audits and transfer-pricing files. Where zero-rating is unproven, the AEDT claws back VAT at 17% with statutory late-payment interest and penalties up to the amount of the tax evaded; criminal tax fraud under Articles 427–428 of the General Tax Law (AO) carries fines of EUR 250–25,000 and/or imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years. The enhanced AML banking tier applicable to this medium-risk battery-metals trader intensifies scrutiny of LC/SWIFT payment trails during refund and audit reviews.

stage_4.account_class: Operational Account (EUR/USD multiproduct); Trade-Finance LC Facility; Capital Escrow Account

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Filing (Dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (LBR/RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within seven months after financial year-end (by 31 July for calendar-year entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine for late filing of EUR 150 to EUR 12,500; persistent non-filing for two years may trigger administrative strike-off and director disqualification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax (IRC) and Municipal Business Tax (ICC) Annual Returns
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing by 31 December of the year following the tax year (audit postponement possible)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 10% on assessed tax; interest of 0.5% per month; fines up to EUR 5,000; eventual enforced assessment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Net Wealth Tax Return (Retour de l’impôt sur la fortune)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing by 31 December of the year following the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty equal to 5% of due net wealth tax per overdue month, capped at 20%; enforcement action possible.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT Return and Recapitulative Statement (TVA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 1 March of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing subject to flat fines of EUR 250–EUR 3,000 and per-month interest; possible VAT audit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Annual Confirmation (Confirmation annuelle au registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE) – Luxembourg Business Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month following the anniversary of initial registration, and immediately upon any change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal penalties for intentional non-confirmation: imprisonment 6 months–3 years and fine up to EUR 125,000.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for SARL exceeding in at least two of three: balance sheet total EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million, or 50 employees (2015 thresholds, updated periodically). Also mandatory for public-interest entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (loi du 19 décembre 2002) under EU Accounting Directive; IFRS required for EU-listed groups; optional for non-listed entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every SARL must confirm the accuracy of UBO data with the RBE at each annual anniversary of its initial RBE filing; any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership must be updated within 30 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% aggregate effective headline rate for a company established in Luxembourg City, comprising 17% corporate income tax, a 7% unemployment fund surcharge on the corporate income tax (yielding an effective central income tax rate of 18.19%), and the communal business tax (impôt commercial communal) at a typical Luxembourg City rate of 6.75%; the communal rate varies by commune.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Luxembourg does not grant blanket statutory tax holidays, but materially reduces effective taxation through the patent box / IP regime under which 80% of qualifying net income from registered IP is exempt, producing an effective corporate income tax rate of roughly 5%; further relief arises from the Luxembourg participation exemption (dividends and capital gains on qualifying shareholdings), a statutory investment tax credit, R&D tax incentives, and the OECD Pillar Two top-up regime now governing groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite - Luxembourg law provides unlimited carry-forward of tax losses without a statutory time limit; utilisation is subject to continued economic activity and anti-abuse rules, particularly where a change of ownership or a material change of business activity occurs; no 5-year cap applies.
